pairs.rule_a_desc: Editing or creating files inside .augment/ directory — skills, rules, commands, templates, contexts must be project-agnostic
pairs.rule_b_desc: Keeping .augment/ contexts, counts, cross-references in sync when creating, renaming, or deleting skills, rules, commands, templates, agent infra

pairs.rule_a_desc: Running CLI commands that produce verbose output — git, tests, linters, docker, build tools, artisan, npm, composer. Wrap with rtk; tail/grep fallback
pairs.rule_b_desc: Running PHP commands inside Docker containers — artisan, composer, phpstan, rector, ecs, phpunit, tests, migrations, and any CLI tool execution

pairs.rule_a_desc: Creating a new skill, rule, command, or guideline, or significantly rewriting one — runs mandatory Understand → Research → Draft before drafting
pairs.rule_b_desc: After creating or significantly improving a skill, rule, guideline, or command — ask if it should be contributed upstream to the shared package

pairs.rule_a_desc: Creating or editing rules, or auditing rule types — decides when a rule should be always vs auto
pairs.rule_b_desc: Creating or editing rules, skills, commands, guidelines, AGENTS.md, or copilot-instructions.md — enforce size and scope limits
